QuestInfo.name: [Glory] Weekly Mission: Investigating Anomalies
QuestInfo.0:
#e#b<Weekly Mission: Investigating Anomalies>#k#n

#eMission Period#n
12/04/2019 12:00 AM - 01/28/2020 11:59 PM UTC

#b#e[Event Details]#n#k
Dimensional pockets have begun to materialize throughout Maple World and Grandis wherein space and time have become entangled. These singularities appears to absorb matter from the surrounding area and grow in power...

Locate these dimensional pockets and eliminate the monsters that lurk inside to force the anomalies to dissipate.


#rThe weekly mission resets every Wednesday at 00:00 AM. You can investigate 30 dimensional pockets per week.
